card.description: Prompt file given to the executor. Its bytes are frozen at submit.

outputs.description: Paths relative to workdir; hashed into the receipt.

command.description: Exit 0 = PASS, 1 = FAIL, anything else = verifier error.

freeze.description: Files whose bytes are frozen at submit.

authority.description: What the controller may do without asking a human.

kind.description: direct (default), pool (Yardgoat pool with pulling stations), file-pool, or a plugin kind

worker_verify.description: command the pool worker runs before marking done

allowed_lanes.description: Enforced at dispatch: the executor lane must be listed.

blocked_file.description: Relative to workdir; if the worker writes it, the task is parked with its content as the question. Default out/BLOCKED.md.

auto_close.description: reconcile runs the frozen verifier on the owner's behalf once a run exits

scope.description: Write set relative to workdir. Literal paths and the directory prefix before the first glob component reserve canonical absolute path prefixes while running. Overlapping scopes queue; omitted or empty scope opts out.

risk.description: l1 documentation; l2 ordinary work; l3 requires explicit approval of the frozen content before dispatch/start/claim.

depends_on.description: Accepted upstream task ids. Every upstream must be verified before this task starts; self-dependencies, missing tasks and dependency cycles are rejected at submit.

on_pass.description: Ordered owner-side shell commands after final PASS, including any configured review loop.

cwd.description: Defaults to workdir; explicit relative paths resolve against the spec directory.

on_pass_timeout.description: Per-step timeout in seconds. Overrides local on_pass_timeout; default 600.

channel.description: Owner-resolved review pool host/lane, frozen at submission and compared with actual run/station channels.

path.description: Directory relative to workdir to snapshot and review. Must be inside workdir; the review workspace and owner store must be outside this directory.

review.description: Automatic frozen verification, independent pool review and bounded repair loop. Pool and effective lane must differ from execution; review enables auto-close.

review_followup.description: Generated follow-up provenance; accepted tasks appear in inbox without automatic dispatch.
